scope: Independent retail-client body evidence for the 37 legacy semantic dependency rows consumed by this catalog.
rule: Address, opcode, size, symbol, or dispatch-edge agreement alone is a cross-check. A closed row requires a body observation that supports the retained label or a narrower replacement label.

rows.supportedLabel: 0x00c9 chat-message sender with a u32 selector and a 0x200-byte text field
rows.observation: The sender writes opcode 0x00c9 and body size 0x218, writes its u32 selector argument at application offset 0, zero-fills the 0x200-byte field at application offset 4 before copying the source text into it, and enqueues through FUN_00DB3E30; these field writes independently establish a selector-tagged chat message, while captures confirm a 552-byte subpacket and 536-byte application body.

rows.supportedLabel: 0x00c8 builder for a 0x230-byte record with 32-byte header data and a 512-byte body block
rows.observation: The builder writes opcode 0x00c8 and size 0x230, copies four qwords and 0x80 dwords, and its sole caller forwards the record through FUN_00DB3E30.

rows.supportedLabel: Session-gated marker update with sixteen 0x28-byte records and a count byte at payload offset 0x290
rows.observation: The handler gates on owner offset 0x4d8, reads packet state, and the apply path consumes sixteen 0x28-byte marker rows with a u8 count at application offset 0x290.

rows.supportedLabel: Packed update containing eight one-bit flags and eight u16 values
rows.observation: The handler expands payload byte 1 into eight flags, reads eight u16 fields at offsets 2 through 0x10, writes the first u16 to owner offset 0x38, and forwards all sixteen values.

rows.supportedLabel: Cutscene and SNPC state update
rows.observation: The callee reads u32 control flags, an s16 actor offset, u8 skin and personality values, a 257-byte cutscene flag bitset, and a 32-byte SNPC name.

rows.supportedLabel: Padded name-string registration update
rows.observation: The handler passes the payload to the shared name registrar and then applies a 32-byte padded ASCII name through the receiver worker; the imported offset-specific suffix is not retained.

rows.supportedLabel: Group-delete update carrying four u64 identifiers
rows.observation: The handler forwards zone context to FUN_006C5DE0; the reached apply path reads four u64 values named by use as control number, group id, zero group id, and confirmed group id. This does not support a generic actor-despawn label.

rows.supportedLabel: Eight-byte member-delegate thunk through owner offset 0x18 to a group-begin payload path
rows.observation: The thunk executes mov ecx,[ecx+0x18] then jumps to FUN_006C2F30; the reached body reads three u64 identifiers and a u32 count.

rows.supportedLabel: Group-completion update carrying three u64 identifiers
rows.observation: The owner-offset 0x18 thunk reaches FUN_006C4180, whose body reads three u64 payload fields and applies completion gating; the imported u32 state-event label is not retained.

rows.supportedLabel: Eight-entry group-member update with 0x30-byte records
rows.observation: The reached body reads location and sequence u64 values, eight 0x30-byte member records, and a member count whose low byte controls iteration.

rows.supportedLabel: Sixteen keyed 0x30-byte records with conditional snapshot and delivery
rows.observation: The thunk reaches FUN_006C2FE0, which reads three u32 key fields at payload offsets 0, 8, and 0x0c and passes sixteen records from offset 0x10. FUN_006C19D0 advances by 0x30 and reads u32 fields at record offsets 0, 4, and 8, u8 flags at 0x0c and 0x0d, and a trailing string at 0x0e before a keyed target lookup and virtual slot-0x40 delivery. When the active-state flags permit it, FUN_006C1040 scans the same sixteen records, allocates a 0x198-byte snapshot for the first matching record, and may suppress delivery.

rows.supportedLabel: Thirty-two keyed 0x30-byte records with conditional snapshot and delivery
rows.observation: The thunk reaches FUN_006C3040, which reads three u32 key fields at payload offsets 0, 8, and 0x0c and passes thirty-two records from offset 0x10. FUN_006C19D0 advances by 0x30 and reads u32 fields at record offsets 0, 4, and 8, u8 flags at 0x0c and 0x0d, and a trailing string at 0x0e before a keyed target lookup and virtual slot-0x40 delivery. When the active-state flags permit it, FUN_006C1040 scans the same thirty-two records, allocates a 0x198-byte snapshot for the first matching record, and may suppress delivery.

rows.supportedLabel: Sixty-four keyed 0x30-byte records with conditional snapshot and delivery
rows.observation: The thunk reaches FUN_006C30A0, which reads three u32 key fields at payload offsets 0, 8, and 0x0c and passes sixty-four records from offset 0x10. FUN_006C19D0 advances by 0x30 and reads u32 fields at record offsets 0, 4, and 8, u8 flags at 0x0c and 0x0d, and a trailing string at 0x0e before a keyed target lookup and virtual slot-0x40 delivery. When the active-state flags permit it, FUN_006C1040 scans the same sixty-four records, allocates a 0x198-byte snapshot for the first matching record, and may suppress delivery.

rows.supportedLabel: Eight-entry content-member update with 0x0c-byte records
rows.observation: The owner-offset 0x18 thunk reaches FUN_006C3100; the body reads location and sequence u64 values, eight 0x0c-byte entries, and a low-byte count.

rows.supportedLabel: Sixteen keyed 0x0c-byte records gated by active state
rows.observation: The thunk reaches FUN_006C3150, which reads three u32 key fields at payload offsets 0, 8, and 0x0c and passes sixteen records from offset 0x10 only when no active-state object exists or its offset-8 flag is zero. FUN_006C1C00 advances by 0x0c, reads u32 fields at record offsets 0 and 4 plus a u8 flag at offset 8, resolves the keyed target through FUN_006D04A0, and delivers each record through virtual slot 0x40; no string field is read.

rows.supportedLabel: Thirty-two keyed 0x0c-byte records gated by active state
rows.observation: The thunk reaches FUN_006C31A0, which reads three u32 key fields at payload offsets 0, 8, and 0x0c and passes thirty-two records from offset 0x10 only when no active-state object exists or its offset-8 flag is zero. FUN_006C1C00 advances by 0x0c, reads u32 fields at record offsets 0 and 4 plus a u8 flag at offset 8, resolves the keyed target through FUN_006D04A0, and delivers each record through virtual slot 0x40; no string field is read.

rows.supportedLabel: Sixty-four keyed 0x0c-byte records gated by active state
rows.observation: The thunk reaches FUN_006C31F0, which reads three u32 key fields at payload offsets 0, 8, and 0x0c and passes sixty-four records from offset 0x10 only when no active-state object exists or its offset-8 flag is zero. FUN_006C1C00 advances by 0x0c, reads u32 fields at record offsets 0 and 4 plus a u8 flag at offset 8, resolves the keyed target through FUN_006D04A0, and delivers each record through virtual slot 0x40; no string field is read.

rows.supportedLabel: Single string-bearing entry factory and queue insertion
rows.observation: The thunk reaches FUN_006CC390 through FUN_006CD790. The body reads u32 values at payload offsets 8 and 0x0c, consumes string objects at offsets 0x10 and 0x20, allocates one 0x40-byte entry builder, and calls FUN_006CBFB0. That factory installs the observed entry-builder vtable, allocates one 0xf8-byte child object, stores it at builder offset 0x38, clears the byte at 0x3c, replaces the prior entry through FUN_006C4330, and enqueues the new pointer through FUN_007238B0. A zero value at payload offset 0x0c selects the sentinel-id branch; there is no record loop or drop gate.

rows.supportedLabel: Counted batch of eight 0x40-byte named-group records
rows.observation: The reached body consumes a 0x208-byte application payload as eight 0x40-byte records plus a low-byte group count at offset 0x200.

rows.supportedLabel: Eight u64/u32 pairs with a low-byte selector at payload offset 0x60
rows.observation: The reached body reads eight u64 identifiers, eight u32 type values, and the low byte of the u32 at offset 0x60 as the active index or iteration selector.

rows.supportedLabel: Occupancy/property update with a 0x40-byte body
rows.observation: The reached body reads a group header, two u32 occupancy-work values, a localized-name id, and a 36-byte occupancy name; the imported WorkSync label is not retained.

rows.supportedLabel: Group layout/member-information update
rows.observation: The reached body reads a group header, u32 group handle and localized-name id, s32 layout id, u8 layout kind, and a 34-byte layout name.

rows.supportedLabel: Shared-work property stream with list id and running-byte count
rows.observation: The thunk reaches a body that reads a u64 list id, a u8 running-byte total, and a variable tagged-property stream; the imported scalar state-event label is not retained.

rows.supportedLabel: Inventory change-begin update carrying one u8 change code
rows.observation: The handler acquires the inventory manager and calls FUN_0076BAD0; the worker reads the low byte at payload offset 0 as the change code.

rows.supportedLabel: No-payload inventory change-finalization path
rows.observation: The handler takes no packet pointer, acquires the inventory manager, and invokes the commit/finalization worker; the imported actor-event label is not retained.

rows.supportedLabel: Inventory set-begin update carrying u32/u16/u16 fields
rows.observation: The handler acquires context and calls FUN_0076BC20; the worker reads a u32 source id, u16 size, and u16 code and gates on the code's low byte.

rows.supportedLabel: No-payload manager setup path
rows.observation: The handler enters the manager path and invokes FUN_0076BE30 without reading application payload bytes; the imported actor-trigger role is not retained.

rows.supportedLabel: Manager update that copies sixteen payload dwords
rows.observation: The manager worker copies sixteen dwords beginning at application offset 8 and leaves the final 32 bytes unread; the imported actor-event role is not retained.

rows.supportedLabel: No-payload manager finalization path
rows.observation: The handler invokes the manager finalization worker without reading application payload bytes; the imported actor-ping role is not retained.

rows.supportedLabel: Multi-subopcode dispatcher with a string-building branch
rows.observation: The 842-byte handler switches on the first payload u32, routes values below 0x10 to a generic worker, handles 0x10 through 0x16 separately, and uses a string-builder chain for subopcode 0x13. The imported system-error and exact-code-count semantics are not retained.

rows.supportedLabel: 0x012e builder for a 0x68-byte body containing sixteen copied dwords
rows.tool: XIVLegacy Ghidra FindOpcodeImmediate.java, DumpFunctionDecomp.java, and analyze_payload_layouts.py
rows.observation: The builder writes opcode 0x012e and body size 0x68, copies sixteen dwords from its sixth argument, and calls FUN_004D6D30 through the map send path; captures confirm a 120-byte total subpacket.

rows.supportedLabel: 0x012f builder for a 0x38-byte parameter/state request
rows.tool: XIVLegacy Ghidra FindOpcodeImmediate.java, DumpFunctionDecomp.java, and analyze_payload_layouts.py
rows.observation: The builder writes opcode 0x012f and body size 0x38, copies a request-id dword and 32 bytes of serialized state, and calls FUN_004D6D30; captures confirm a 72-byte total subpacket. This supports a parameter/state request rather than an ActorWorkUpdate semantic.

rows.supportedLabel: 0x0131 builder for a 0x18-byte packet containing a u32 id and u8 package id
rows.observation: The builder writes opcode 0x0131 and size 0x18, writes a u32 actor/id field and u8 package id, and calls FUN_004D6D30 through the map send path.

rows.supportedLabel: 0x0132 builder for a 0x18-byte packet containing u32/u16/u8 fields
rows.observation: The builder writes opcode 0x0132 and size 0x18, writes a u32 item-or-actor id, u16 work id, and u8 work value, and calls FUN_004D6D30 through the map send path.

rows.supportedLabel: 0x0134 builder for a 0x28-byte body containing two u32 values and a 16-byte generated nonce buffer
rows.observation: The builder writes opcode 0x0134 and body size 0x28, writes its u32 argument at application offset 0 and a u32 token-helper result at offset 4, writes a 16-byte nonce buffer containing 15 generated ASCII letters and a trailing NUL at offsets 8 through 0x17 as two qwords, and sends through FUN_004D6D30.

rows.supportedLabel: 0x0135 builder for a 0x18-byte packet containing one u32 payload value
rows.observation: The builder writes opcode 0x0135 and body size 0x18, copies its one u32 payload value to application offset 0, and calls FUN_004D6D30; its sole caller is FUN_00705EB0. Neither the builder nor the absent capture evidence establishes BindingSubscribeRequest, binding-id, or subscription-type semantics.
rows.missingEvidence: Capture or local retail-client evidence that assigns binding-id and subscription-type meanings to the one u32 payload value.

rows.supportedLabel: 0x012d builder for a 0xc8-byte tagged application body
rows.tool: XIVLegacy Ghidra FindOpcodeImmediate.java, DumpFunctionDecomp.java, and analyze_payload_layouts.py
rows.observation: The builder writes opcode 0x012d and body size 0xc8, stages four u32 values, one u8, 32 bytes, and 128 bytes, then sends through FUN_004D6D30, FUN_004E0240, and FUN_00DAE010; captures confirm a 216-byte total subpacket.
